title: What is still owed
description: GET /v1/next/obligations. The route that replaces asking: every row names who can clear it, how long it has been owed, and how loud it has become. Every row is a projection of the broker's own records — one per task whose landing is still pending, named against the terminal its root is in now, or a person for a task with no root — recomputed at every read and stored nowhere else (docs/design-decisions.md D01). A broker ledger holding a row it cannot decode is answered as a refusal, never as a shorter list.

Escalation.description: How loud an obligation has become. Escalation changes visibility, never verdict: nothing here ever declares a session dead.

stuck.description: How many rows are past their overdue threshold. A count, not a verdict.
